verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a Graph view in which each link between notes becomes a line, showing the local neighbourhood around the open note. The evidence describes only a per-object local graph, not exploration of the whole knowledge base, and gives no detail on interactivity or filtering. Backlinks and block references supply the connections the graph draws on. Missing for 10: whole-knowledge-base (global) graph exploration, filtering of the graph to chosen types or tags, documented interactive navigation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
